subject: SummitRx kickoff — stakeholders, legal lane, and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitrx.com>, procurement@summitrx.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitRx kickoff — stakeholders, legal lane, and next steps

Thanks again for a productive call earlier, Maya — appreciate the time and the clarity around what success looks like for SummitRx. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (short)
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for clinical batch scoring and enable secure private deployment for PHI-proximal models.
- Key success metrics: 95th perc latency < 250ms for 512-token batches; per-token cost target ~ $0.0008 when billed.

Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Champion / Technical owner: Maya Patel (Data Science) — owns evaluation, model inputs, and runbooks.
- Economic buyer: Eleanor Shaw, CFO (expects consolidated cost estimate for Q3 renewals).
- Security/compliance: Anil Desai (Head of InfoSec) — will validate data paths, DPA, and audit logs.
- Procurement / legal intake: procurement@summitrx.com (procurement lead) and legal: Lena Ortiz (contracts).

Immediate asks / proposed sequencing
1) NDA: you mentioned procurement can circulate the company NDA to speed legal intake. We can sign that first to exchange internal artifacts. Typical turn time: 48 business hours for an exec-signed NDA.
2) MAAP: attached a one-page mutual action plan (SummitRx_MAAP_v1.xlsx) that sequences discovery -> security review -> pilot -> DPA/MSA. Please review and edit stakeholders/timelines.
3) Security artifacts: we can prepare our SOC 2 summary, data retention notes, and a short architecture diagram for Anil. What next date works for a follow-up security sync?
4) Pricing & pilot scope: propose a 6-week pilot with 2 GPUs dedicated for the first tranche; I’ll put a draft cost estimate in the MAAP.

Proposed next steps (concrete)
- Maya: confirm legal intake contact (is Lena the primary contract reviewer?) and whether procurement will send the NDA or prefer a Redwood template.
- Procurement: send NDA to my attention and CC ben.carter@redwood.inference; we’ll turn around exec-signed versions quickly.
- Anil/InfoSec: availability for a 30–45m security sync next week.

Attachment: SummitRx_MAAP_v1.xlsx (MAAP with timeline and owners)

Thanks — looping in Ben to own commercial cadence and Jasmine for legal ops once we have the NDA or redline thread.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — inference that ships
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitrx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@summitrx.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitRx kickoff — stakeholders, legal lane, and next steps

Thanks, Karthik — that's a helpful summary and close to what I have. A few clarifications and next items from our side: 

- Legal intake / procurement: I looped in procurement@ (they own the contract queue). Our general flow is NDA -> DPA (data processing) -> MSA. Our contracts lead is Lena Ortiz (lena.ortiz@summitrx.com) — she handles initial redlines and will route to GC for final review.
- Economic buyer: Eleanor Shaw (CFO) is the approval authority on any multi-quarter commit; she wants a short one-page TCO showing pilot-to-prod run rates.
- Security: Anil Desai (anil.desai@summitrx.com) will want an architecture diagram and our SOC2 + encryption at rest details. He suggested a 30m sync Tue 16 Mar 10:00 PT if that works.

NDA: procurement is attaching our standard exec NDA (see attached SummitRx_Exec_NDA_Signed.pdf) — it's signed by our CTO and should be sufficient to exchange artifacts. Please countersign and return; procurement will route DPA once the NDA is in place.

Timeline constraints:
- Procurement has a weekly contract triage on Fridays; if we can have countersigned NDA by Thu 18th, they can slot DPA review into next week's triage.
- CFO-level econ approval window in late March (they need numbers by 3/24).

I'll take a look at your MAAP and propose edits inline. Thanks for pulling this together — happy to drive internal alignment and get procurement to prioritize.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director, Data Science | SummitRx Therapeutics
maya.patel@summitrx.com | +1 (617) 555-0987
Attachment: SummitRx_Exec_NDA_Signed.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitrx.com>, lena.ortiz@summitrx.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>, procurement@summitrx.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitRx kickoff — stakeholders, legal lane, and next steps

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Maya. Confirming next actions from Redwood: 

1) NDA countersign: Ben will review the attached exec NDA and return a countersigned copy by EOD Fri (we can do an exec sign on our side and scan/return).
2) MAAP update: I updated the MAAP with the proposed pilot size and an estimated cost row for the CFO packet. Link in the MAAP (attached) and I'll push a clean copy to the HubSpot deal (see link).
3) Legal sequencing recommendation (our suggested order):
   - NDA (sign to exchange internal docs) — target turn time: 2 business days
   - DPA (data processing specifics + logging/audit) — target turn time: 5–7 business days after initial redline
   - MSA (commercial terms + SLA) — target turn time: 7–10 business days once core DPA scopes are agreed
4) Redline cadence: to minimize churn we recommend: procurement/Legal shares their redlines to a single doc (we prefer DocuSign/Drive link) and copy jasmine.liu@redwood.inference so our legal ops can triage and produce a clean counter.
I attached the updated MAAP (SummitRx_MAAP_v1.xlsx) with owner columns filled — Ben will follow up on commercial cadence and econ materials for Eleanor. Jasmine — could you please take point on the redline intake and let Lena know the best place to share comments?
Thanks everyone — looks like we have clear owners and a reasonable timeline. If the Tue 16 Mar security sync works, I'll add a short agenda and invite Anil + our infra security lead for the call.
Best,
Karthik

--
Ben Carter (cc'ed) | Head of Sales, West Region | Redwood Inference
Jasmine Liu (cc'ed) | Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
